title: Burning pain in the upper stomach after meals; vague patient, a brisk doctor, a nurse and a phlebotomist
description: Fictional synthetic consultation for Module 3 testing; not a real patient record or medical advice.

design.opening: the doctor checks the patient's name and date of birth against the screen
design.patient_style: vague, uses everyday words ('a burn', 'a funny turn', 'bad tummy') and needs the doctor to translate
deliberately_absent: the doctor does not give a diagnosis or name what he thinks it is
partial_or_uncertain: what he takes for it ('the pink stuff') is described, not named
how long it has gone on: 'since the Jubilee' is his reference point
the nurse measures only a few values
facts: burning pain in the upper stomach after meals, worse with spicy food and lying down
some waking at night, a sour taste
no vomiting blood, black stools, trouble swallowing, weight loss
high blood pressure and a previous ulcer
father had stomach problems and mother had thyroid trouble
works nights as a delivery driver, smokes about ten a day, two or three pints at weekends
pulse and blood pressure taken, weight taken
plan: breath test for the stomach bug, bloods taken by the phlebotomist, camera test of the stomach if it persists, lifestyle advice
